description.p: Tangent lets you write the way you think. Your thoughts are connected; Tangent lets you link to existing notes and make new ones with ease. Let your mind wander along the path of interest. Don't suppress tangential thoughts; embrace them. Key features include:

ul.li: [[Wiki-link]] linking to other files in your workspace by name.
Horizontally-scrolling sliding panels for quickly moving back and forth along a trail of thoughts.
A Map View of the links between notes created and followed during your current session.
Note creation automation with support for creating notes within folders defined by wildcards.
Full-workspace note search powered by a custom query language.

description.p: Tangent reads and writes plaintext notes using a loose interpretation of Markdown syntax. Text is rendered in a pseudo-WYSIWYG style, with formatting characters appearing only when you need them. Tangent supports bold, italics, headers, lists, links, images, todos, tags, inline code, block code with syntax highlighting, inline and block KaTeX math, color highlights, strikethrough, and comments.

ul.li: Added commands for activating color highlights. They are now accessible from the application and context menus and can have keyboard shortcuts bound to them.
Added a command for toggling checkboxes on and off (Ctrl+[).
Added custom styling for checkboxes and range sliders that correctly invoke the configured accent color.
Fixed an issue where automatic word finding (e.g. for inline formatting toggles) did not detect non-Latin words.
Fixed an issue where Math, Mermaid Diagrams, and Highlights did not correctly fade out in focus mode.
Fixed an issue where the currently selected settings tab wasn't obvious in light mode.
Fixed an issue where hitting enter after "- [] 1" removed that line.
Fixed an issue that caused errors in Mermaid Diagrams to add elements in the background, eventually breaking layout.
Fixed an issue where headers with adjacent space-like elements (e.g. My - Header) would not be matched properly.
Fixed an issue where the images of website previews were not horizontally centered.
Added "Open to the Right/Left/Replace" options to the context menu of files and folders in the sidebar.
Changed the "trash items on delete" default to false on Linux. This caused friction for many.
Added gray emoji-based highlight options.
Changed the configuration of "safe header" names to be much more lenient, allowing for non-latin headers.
Fixed an issue where Wiki Links to headers that had extra whitespace around them couldn't match their target header.
Fixed an issue where shifting list items up with more than two other list items below it garbled the state of the list.
Added a "Copy Relative Path" command.
Added support for panning in PDFs by holding space while clicking and dragging.
Added support for shifting scroll direction in images and PDFs by holding shift while dragging.
Fixed an issue where shifting ordered lists with keyboard shortcuts didn't re-order the list glyphs.
Fixed an issue where completing a wiki link by typing didn't correctly exit autocomplete.
Added an exploratory fix for an issue related to duplicate session keys.
Added a command for copying the full path of a file or folder with Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C.
Fixed a bug where attempting to drag-select a range that was larger than the editor would cause the editor to constantly scroll to the top of the selection.
Fixed a bug where selecting a range larger than the editor with cursor keys did not show the leading edge of selection.
Embed links on their own line now collapse the text, removing the empty gap. This can be disabled in settings.
Added support for floating embedded images, videos, etc. to the left or right.
Added support for controlling the width and height of all embedded content.
Added support for zooming on PDF views.
Added support for treating + as the equivalent to x for completing Todos, allowing RTL language detection to not get tripped up.
Added unicode replacement support for double arrows (⟹, ⇒, ⇐, ⟸).
Added a Startup Behavior option that lets you choose between restoring old windows or always showing the workspace selector.
Added a setting for code tab size.
Fixed an issue where headers in RTL languages did not work correctly.
Fixed an issue where the Cards Lens did not correctly render RTL languages.
Fixed a leak where links in closed notes retained node handles on their target files and folders.
Fixed an embedded PDF scaling issue unique to Windows 10.
Fixed an issue where Wiki Links could not link to notes with brackets in their name.
Fixed an issue where raw links auto-embedded in sub-lists but not in top-level lists.
Fixed an issue where the scroll position of the Map View wasn't correctly cached.
Fixed an issue where code tab size was a non-integer value.
Fixed an issue where right-gutter elements could be misaligned.
Fixed an issue where code blocks did not respond to panes resizing and did not shrink back down.
Fixed a regression where the first character of $math$ notation was not rendered.
The Details Panel is universal across all views, making backlinks accessible anywhere.
Creation Rules now support Content Templates. Template tokens are highlighted within notes, and include explanatory tooltips and autocomplete.
Creation Rules of parent folders now show up in the creation rule list of sub-folders that would be affected.
ISO week numbers are now supported in Creation Rule name and content templates.
Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+Up opens the settings panel in the current pane. Pane settings can be navigated by the keyboard.
The Feed, Cards, and List Lenses can be navigated with the keyboard.
Added the "Move to Left Note" Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+Left shortcut to move keyboard focus to the Sidebar. Pressing Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+Right while focus is in the sidebar returns focus to the leftmost pane.
The - and * list characters are now treated as different kinds. Swapping between them in a list will propagate that change to all lower siblings.
List glyphs automatically change as you indent, progressing from alpha to numeric and * to -. This can be disabled in the note settings.
Added support for 1) and A) style ordered lists. These count as "large lists" in the same way as * unordered lists.
Added support for using several unicode bullet characters (e.g. •, ◦, ⁍, ‣, ❧) as list glyphs.
Added the ability to link to specific PDF page numbers and to times in audio and video files.
Embedded PDF files now show the entire linked page.
Added the option in the context menu to update an image from the clipboard.
Added .webp image files to the image allow list.
Added display of link context on the Map View when available.
Sentence focus will highlight the previous sentence if the cursor is within trailing whitespace of a line. This leaves the last sentence highlighted when you haven't yet started a new one.
Changed the word count mechanism, improving non-latin word counts.
Added support for drag-dropping files in the sidebar to root.
Made the floating "Create" button universal across the Folder, Feed, and List Lenses.
Added an option to base keyboard shortcuts on keycode values, keeping them in the same physical location as locales change.
Added support for unbalanced parentheses in markdown links when urls are wrapped in angle brackets.
Added a setting to disable auto-updates.
Added support for updating links to folders when folders are renamed.
Added support for only showing spell check in filenames and note content when that note or filename has editing focus. Enabled by default.
Changed the default font to the more modern system-ui.
Updated to Electron 42.1 and Svelte 5.
Fixed an issue where thousands of in-note-search results could cause dramatic performance issues by limiting the number of rendered annotations.
Fixed a bug where queries that had wiki references after text filters did not correctly filter data.
Fixed a bug where $math$ required whitespace to the left of the opening character.
Fixed a bug where wiki link autocomplete with aliases and headers was broken.
Fixed a bug with Emoji Highlights that incorrectly hid the last character.
Fixed a long-standing bug where a window's "maximized" state was not recorded and restored.
Fixed an issue where extra Referer header data present for embedding YouTube videos caused remote images to not load successfully.
Fixed an issue where content_id (e.g. #Header) information on a link would be lost when that link was updated while renaming the target file.
Fixed an issue where inline formatting could activate incorrectly. e.g. === will no longer trigger highlights.
Fixed an issue where the text carat was hard to read in highlighted text.

Fixed an issue where trying to toggle on an inline style with a collapsed selection somewhat before an existing inline range of the same style could toggle off that second style rather than adding a new inline range.
Fixed an issue where clicking on the gutter of a note would select the bottom of the note rather than the beginning or end of the closest paragraph.
Removed tooltips when hovering over embedded content to reduce obnoxious distraction.
Fixed several issues that resulted in maps responding to the delete key when they shouldn't.
Fixed an issue where editing a filename responded to shortcuts for bold, italic, etc.
Fixed several issues with searching for diacritics with latin characters, and added support for finding ł with l.
Fixed an issue where adding new lines around lists could mangle the list formatting.
Fixed an issue where lone $ characters could break immediately-following inline formatting.
Fixed an issue with HTML parsing where sequential newlines were not handled correctly.
Fixed an issue where moving a file out of a folder didn't immediately update the folder view.
Fixed an issue where you could not collapse second tier list items.
Added support for code blocks defined by more than three backticks.
Fixed an issue where editing code blocks could break the ability to collapse code blocks.
Fixed an issue where styling markup immediately after the beginning of block quotes were not processed correctly.
Fixed an issue where pressing Delete while renaming elements in the sidebar deleted those items.
Added support for displaying and embedding local video, audio, and pdf files.
Added support for displaying Mermaid Diagrams inside of Code blocks.
Added the ability to customize keyboard shortcuts throughout Tangent.
Added support for checked and enabled status for note formatting commands.
Added tooltips for files in the sidebar.
Added a "copy section" button to the line gutter. Code, math, and front-matter blocks copy their contents. Hold "Shift" to copy surrounding markdown syntax.
Added support for copying local .png .jpeg files directly to the clipboard.
Added support for navigating the sidebar with keyboard keys and invoking "rename" via a shortcut.
Added support for custom shortcuts for [[Creation Rules]].
Updated the icon for macOS Tahoe.
Added support for specifying a folder over a note with a trailing slash.
Added support for nested and escaped brackets in markdown links.
Added support for autocompleting ... to … (ellipses).
Mirrored the name of the note in the note settings pane for consistency.
Improved the readability and reliability of YAML parsing errors.
Fixed an issue where parsing could crash from YAML that parsed but could not be translated to a JS object.
Fixed an issue where link preview cards lacked all style in production.
Fixed an issue where directory-based search matches could be prioritized over direct filename matches.
Fixed an issue where the YouTube embedder rejected Tangent's requests due to a missing "referrer" header.
Fixed an issue where the accent color hue could not be set to the full 360° hue space.
Fixed an issue where the settings panel for a pane could remain open even when your mouse leaves the panel.
Fixed an issue where long note titles wrapped in the vertical toolbar.
Fixed a crash that could occur at startup. Added logging to gain more information.
Pressing escape now dismisses any active annotations or search highlights in a note.
Completed or canceled Todos are now no longer crossed out while selected.
Fixed an issue that caused scrolling up in the [[Feed Lens]] to jump around obnoxiously.
Fixed an issue where deleting text at the beginning of a line deleted text at the top of the document.
Fixed an issue where section collapsed controls were impossible to click for indented lines.
Fixed an issue where notes would scroll to their selection even when their selection hadn't changed.
Added support for Collapsing Sections. Headers, lists, code, math, and front matter can all be collapsed. Collapsed state is kept persistent between sessions.
Added an option to automatically collapse Front Matter.
Made the Creation Rule name template tokens clickable buttons for easier editing.
Added the Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+Shift+K shortcut for inserting wiki links with the selected text as the display text.
Added support for adding links from the context menu.
Exposed formatting toggles from the context menu.
Added support for linking directly to header id links in markdown links.
Added support for restoring selection and scroll position in notes between sessions.
Added support for searching for and navigating to headers from the Cmd/Ctrl+O search menu.
Made tag search not relative to the last name item, better matching user intuition.
Updated to Electron 37.
Fixed an issue where the note editor fallback feature wasn't correctly invoked.
Fixed an issue where link data could be incorrect after editing links.
Fixed an issue where closing inline formatting at the end of a link broke link parsing.
Fixed several issues with selection and annotation initialization when opening notes.
Added support for link previews, with support for website previews, audio, video, and youtube links. Raw links on their own line are automatically previewed.
Added support for displaying HTML with syntax highlighting.
Hovering over wiki-links now show a preview of the note's contents.
Changed scrolling cards in the Cards Lens to require alt by default. This can be changed within settings.
Added support for Shifting Sections with Alt+Shift+Up/Down on Windows and Linux and ⌃⌥+Up/Down on Mac.
Added an option to follow links with unmodified left clicks.
Added an option to always autocomplete the full workspace path for Wiki Links.
Added an option to control whether finished Todos are crossed out.
Added support for selecting different code highlighting themes.
Added support for searching within a single file.
Added support for indenting headers, code blocks, math blocks, and quotes.
Added support for unicode autocomplete in note titles.
Added the List Lens and greatly improved the Card and Feed lenses.
Switched to using the computer name instead of hostname when identifying a machine in workspace data.
Added an option on linux and windows to use the native titlebar. Defaults to on for linux, off for windows.
Added error and warning indicators for YAML parsing errors in Front Matter.
Changed default Bold and Italics behavior so that underscores surrounded by text does not trigger formatting.
Updated Electron to v35.4.0.
Fixed an issue where query editor selection could be lost.
Fixed an issue where you couldn't open a new query from the Map.
Fixed an issue where query results could come out of order.
Fixed HTML parsing to only start on valid tag names.
Updated to Electron v34.0.0.
Fixed an issue where autocomplete menus were not dismissed by clicking outside of the menu.
Fixed an issue where query refreshes could be caused by routine internal file changes within the `.tangent` folder.
Removed donation links in compliance with new work terms.
